remainingGaps: Exhaustive parallel numbering remains unverified. Only Aqua Equinox /199 and Superfractor 1/1 are stated for the full 200-card base program; no limits are copied to other colors, inserts or autographs.

Tom Brady EQA-TB Red Flare is a five-copy print-limit example, not evidence of serial marking or a family-wide /5 ladder. Caleb Williams EQA-CWI Orange Galactic is explicitly numbered to 25 only for that example.
